A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 44-page versions of the same study, with matching main sections and Appendices A–J. Text extraction and visual inspection support comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v3 reports original ESM-3 and ESM-C prediction accuracies, circuit-intervention results, and attention-head and neuron analyses, including appendix experiments.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results, including Table 1's prediction accuracies and the supplementary experiments in Appendices C–J.

M1.justification: The models, AP-IG/EAP-IG procedures, attention-head clustering, and neuron-concept analysis are retained. Table 8's corrected indices match its existing procedural description; no changed underlying algorithm is established.

E1.justification: Both versions use synthetic repeats, UniRef50 identical and substitution-based approximate repeats, and the same insertion/deletion scenario in Appendix C.

E2.justification: Comparison and control membership is unchanged, including the alternative counterfactual strategies in Appendix G and the random-token baseline for neuron-concept matching in Appendix J.3. Both PLMs remain analyzed.

E3.justification: Masking rules, model sizes, discovery/evaluation sample sizes, faithfulness thresholds, and accuracy/AUROC evaluation procedures are retained. Table 8's index repairs align the feature equations with their unchanged verbal definitions.

E4.justification: Neuron pruning, failure analyses by repeat length and substitution rate, counterfactual robustness tests, clustering analyses, and supplementary neuron examples are retained without changed evidence.

E5.justification: Both retain five discovery/evaluation runs with different random seeds, the same variability reporting, and the same statistical clustering checks in Appendix I.4.2.

E6.justification: Table 1 retains accuracies of 99.8%, 99.0%, and 79.0% for ESM-3 and 99.9%, 99.4%, and 79.7% for ESM-C on synthetic, identical, and approximate repeats. Circuit results, plotted findings, and appendix results also match.

T1.justification: Appendix I.2, Table 8 corrects the copying argmax to use A_h^(s)[m(s),j] and the pattern-matching sum to use A_h^(s)[q,k]. In v3 these index expressions were interchanged, leaving variables unbound. v5 also makes j*(s) explicit. This is a localized mathematical correction.

C1.justification: The central claims remain that approximate-repeat circuits generalize to exact repeats and combine induction mechanisms with biologically specialized components. The claimed similarities and differences between ESM-3 and ESM-C are unchanged.

C2.justification: The three-stage mechanism interpretation, explanations of component roles and model differences, and limitations concerning two repeat occurrences, substitution rates, and manually defined concepts are retained.

D1.justification: Data-curation and implementation disclosures in Appendices B, H, and J are unchanged, as is the page 1 code/data availability statement. No new implementation or access information is supplied.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to prior repeat-detection methods, LLM induction mechanisms, and PLM interpretability research are unchanged.

P1.justification: The introduction corrects 'biological Out' to 'biological properties'; Figure 1 contains small wording edits, and Appendix I.2 removes shorthand replaced by explicit notation. The section order and narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 changes its stage colors and some labels. Figure 9 moves from the right column to beneath Figure 8 in the left column, with modest surrounding text and table reflow. No displays are added or removed.

improvement.justification: Correcting Table 8's inconsistent indices makes the induction-score definition mathematically coherent and consistent with its description. This provides a limited precision gain despite a small new grammatical slip in Figure 1 ('a single amino acids'). The experimental evidence and conclusions are unchanged.
